deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Ethereum core table separately binds wsrUSD, srUSD and Saving Module. Sourcify Savingcoin constructor and immutable asset bytecode bind this wsrUSD directly to rUSD, not srUSD. Non-proxy deployment; no implementation substitution or unbound generic ERC4626 ABI used.

abiEvidence.evidence: Complete exact-deployment ABI retained unchanged. SHA256 hashes identify retrieved source content, not Solidity keccak hashes. Source-service match labels are recorded verbatim, not independently refreshed runtime proof.

underlyingEvidence.evidence: Stablecoin inherits ERC20Burnable: burnFrom spends caller allowance and burns user rUSD; mint requires MINTER. rUSD decimals returns 18. wsrUSD source routes all four savings methods through this exact asset; users are not required to hold the rUSD MINTER role.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official website links the app/docs; maintained documentation index presents wsrUSD mint/redeem as current, not retired. Etherscan historical pages report successful deposit at block 25964162 on 2026-09-12 and successful redeem at block 26034638 on 2026-09-22; address page lists approvals through 2026-10-22. These establish recent historical use, not current runtime/role state or DAU. Official linked repository latest returned commit is 95c83d4512a1042f241842431d53d44c0d204801, 2024-12-17; do not call that recent source maintenance. No lifecycle exclusion found in reviewed official/current sources.

scaleEvidence.evidence: Page displays protocol-wide TVL about $69.3m and Ethereum TVL about $2.2m. Neither is wsrUSD-specific vault TVL; no DAU/active-user figure is established. Synthetic burn/mint savings notional must not be inferred from this contract token balance.

sourceSemantics.underlying: Immutable rUSD, 18 decimals. Savingcoin overrides _deposit and _withdraw: burnFrom/mint on rUSD, not token transfers to/from a funded ERC4626 vault. wsrUSD also has 18 decimals through zero decimals offset. srUSD and Saving Module remain out of scope.
sourceSemantics.conversion: Let F=floor(compoundFactorAccum * _compoundFactor(currentRate,block.timestamp,lastTimestamp)/RAY). shares=floor(assets*RAY/F); assets=floor(shares*F/RAY). _compoundFactor=RAY+n*r+n*(n-1)*floor(r*r/RAY)/2+n*(n-1)*(n-2)*floor(r*r/RAY)*r/RAY/6 with Solidity integer divisions. No virtual balances or totalAssets/balanceOf ratio in conversion. All rounding arguments ignored, including mint/withdraw requested ceil. Arithmetic overflow reverts.
sourceSemantics.limits: _deposit checks cap >= converted(shares+totalSupply). Default cap 0, rate 0, accumulated factor RAY; manager can change cap/rate. Inherited maxDeposit/maxMint do not incorporate cap. Ordinary user calls not role-gated and no pause/blacklist code; exits rely on externally revocable rUSD MINTER permission. Owner delegation consumes share allowance.
sourceSemantics.exits: Synchronous rUSD mint on share burn, no lockup, queue, pending request, slippage bounds or deadline. Underlying PSM redemption to USDC is not included, and liquidity remarks in product documentation must not be misrepresented as a wsrUSD token-balance liquidity check. No fees in reviewed wsrUSD methods.
sourceSemantics.eligibility: Savings docs exclude US and sanctioned-country users. Terms revised 2024-08-23 restrict prohibited persons and require eligibility; code-level permissionlessness does not override terms.

selectedFunctions.label: Reservoir wsrUSD deposit
warnings: Ethereum Savingcoin wsrUSD takes and returns rUSD (0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34), not srUSD or USDC. Assets and shares both use 18-decimal raw units. It is not a 1:1 srUSD wrapper: deposit/mint burn caller rUSD and mint wsrUSD; withdraw/redeem burn wsrUSD and mint rUSD.

Deposit/mint require rUSD balance and allowance to this wsrUSD contract. The manager-controlled notional cap is checked in _deposit, but inherited maxDeposit/maxMint return uint256 max and do not report cap availability. Cap starts at zero in the constructor; current cap and rate were not read by RPC. Check transaction conditions before signing.

All four conversion paths use integer floor division because Savingcoin ignores the requested ERC4626 rounding direction, including mint and withdraw (normally ceil). Small nonzero amounts may produce zero shares or zero assets; mint can undercharge by rounding and withdraw can burn fewer shares than standard ERC4626 rounding. No minimum output, maximum input or deadline argument protects a quote.

Rate is manager-controlled and accrues by block timestamp using a third-order binomial approximation in RAY (1e27), not an exact exponent and not a fixed APY. Accumulated factor and currentRate determine conversion; token donations/balanceOf do not. The apy() getter returns the one-year compounded factor including principal in RAY, not the advertised percentage net of principal.

No lock, maturity, cooldown, queue, settlement or fee is implemented by these wsrUSD calls. Exit pays newly minted rUSD immediately, not USDC; converting rUSD to collateral through the PSM is separate, unadmitted and liquidity-dependent. Delegated exit requires sufficient owner wsrUSD allowance; receiver must be nonzero.

Ordinary calls have no user role/whitelist or pause modifier in the reviewed Savingcoin and rUSD sources. However exits require wsrUSD to retain rUSD MINTER permission, which rUSD administrators can revoke; all exits revert if that dependency is removed. Historical successful redemption is evidence for its transaction block only, not a current role attestation. Managers can change cap/rate; administrators can change manager/minter roles.

Official savings documentation restricts eligibility to non-US users and non-sanctioned countries; absence of on-chain user gating is not permission to bypass legal eligibility. Respect the current protocol terms.

Sourcify reports exact_match creation/runtime and isProxy=false for this deployment. These are retrieved source-service labels, not a fresh RPC/runtime or storage attestation. Reviewed official pages and historical successful calls contain no retirement/shutdown notice; source repository latest returned commit is 2024-12-17, so recent source-code maintenance is not established. No DAU/high-user-activity claim is made.
